name: Tiny Tims
description: Tiny Tims was a mid-1950s street gang based in the Bedford-Stuyvesant neighborhood of Brooklyn, New York. They were closely allied with the Buccaneers — so closely that police and outsiders often regarded them as a single gang. Both groups were among several gangs in the Marcy-Sumner Projects area and were frequently at odds with the Marcy Chaplains. On June 18, 1955, Chaplains members murdered Fred Warren, a Tiny Tims member, marking one of the year's documented gang killings. By 1961 the Buccaneers/Tiny Tims alliance was implicated in multiple killings of Stompers/Medallion Lords/Imperial Lords members.

sources.title: Marcy, Sumner and a Nest of Youth Gangs — New York City Fighting Gangs
